title: Enjoy a Guided Walking Food Tour in the Heart of Austin
includes: Public transportation (bus, subway, cable car, etc.) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your tour will be led by a foodie. These tours have been validated and enjoyed by your guide and your guide wants to share what is delicious about Austin. Bring an appetite and your walking shoes. 
This will be a fun experience that will leave you ready to make reservations with each restaurant.
